verdict.rationale: Metorial documents uploading your own MCP server code and hosting it, with Metorial handling scaling and monitoring. That covers the hosted custom-code half of the story, but the uploaded code must already be an MCP server, so 'no protocol plumbing' is not shown. Nothing in the evidence shows OpenAPI-to-MCP conversion; the openapi.json probe is Metorial's own API spec. Missing for 10: OpenAPI-definition-to-MCP-server generation, evidence that custom code can be hosted without writing MCP protocol handling, in-depth docs on the custom-provider workflow, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can turn an existing API definition (OpenAPI) or custom code into a hosted MCP server without writing protocol plumbing

citations.quote: you can upload your own MCP server code and let Metorial host it. Metorial handles scaling and monitoring.
